scope: native/app source scaffold, not an archived iOS binary

flows.data: Food diary entries, portions, private notes, nutrient snapshots, recipes and favorites
flows.storage: WKWebView IndexedDB plus local protected Application Support archive
flows.transmission: None by this implementation; only user-initiated Files export
flows.deletion: Existing local delete plus native archive clear; app uninstall removes app storage

flows.data: Saved restaurant orders and UI preferences
flows.limitation: Saved notebook is separate from diary JSON

flows.transmission: GET, credentials omitted, no referrer; no raw diary or body inputs
flows.reviewGate: Confirm hosting IP/access-log retention before App Store Connect privacy label

flows.destination: iOS system share sheet after explicit action
flows.transmission: User chooses recipient; private diary is not included in ordinary public order shares

flows.destination: iOS Files document picker after explicit action
flows.transmission: User-selected Files provider may sync the chosen file; warning states it contains private notes

flows.destination: External HTTPS URL after explicit tap
flows.transmission: Opens outside the bundled bridge; third-party policy applies
